title: Evaluation of rare earth elements (REEs) in selected Nigerian coal fly ash: a prelude to extraction and waste management
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00164H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Theophilus Ile Ojonimi, Janne Pesonen, Ferdinard Asuke, Ramalan Aliyu Mohammed, Ilemona Okeme, John Groppo
REEs in the selected fly ash samples were quantified. Results indicate potentially extractable total REEs. Findings are useful for waste management and extraction routes development.
